reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, and I have a drawer of half-used bottles. Sachets for travel are a nice idea, but I don't need it to go.
objection: I don't have a problem this solves. I already have magnesium at home and I'm not paying $30 a month to have the same thing in a foil packet.
would_change_my_mind: A smaller trial pack for a trip, around $10 to $12, so I could try the sachets without committing to 30 days.
